summary: This final-cycle set is clean and well-balanced across model news, AI-ecosystem security, policy, infrastructure, and practitioner analysis. Sam_Badawi still holds two slots, but both are distinct stories and within the author cap of 2, and no hard duplicates or traceability failures remain. Accept the set as-is.
